name: ORCA_HOTEL
source:
The protagonist Ruri awakens in the mysterious Orca Hotel, sunk beneath the ocean floor.

Why is she here? Why has she slept for thousands of years? Why is the hotel submerged? Her memory is completely blank.

Alongside her, Kiga Kaito and Iruka Hibiki also awaken in the hotel, both of them also having lost their memories.

Work together with them to explore this hotel and uncover a way to escape!

Yet as they explore, the shadows of past events haunting this hotel begin to surface...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13054]Novelgame[/url]]
